source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public 13–15, 16:1–35 and 18 align directly. Public 16:36–50 maps to Hebrew 17:1–15; public 17:1–13 maps to Hebrew 17:16–28. All 214 original records, including every annotation, are hashed exactly. Later numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps Hoshea here so verse 16’s naming notice remains visible; no premature harmonization to Joshua.
Retains both tribal designations and clarifies their apposition without emending the Hebrew.
Collective English follows the expedition context; notes the singular Hebrew arrival verb without silently naming Caleb. Keeps seven-year comparison.
Preserves the devouring-land image and universal exaggeration as quoted report, not narrator-certified geography.
Keeps Nephilim and the ancestry clause in the pinned Hebrew; preserves both perspectives as the scouts’ claim.
